28204.explanation:
A sovereign state is one having a permanent population, defined territory, one government, and the capacity to enter into relations with other sovereign states. It is also normally understood that a sovereign state is neither dependent on nor subjected to any other power or state.

28254.subject: Government
28254.question_text: One significant aspect of the legislative council of 19922 was that
28254.explanation:
Under the Clifford Constitution (1922), the Legislative Council’s authority applied mainly to the Southern Provinces (and Lagos). The Northern Protectorate was excluded from its legislative jurisdiction because it was still governed separately through indirect rule under the Governor and local traditional authorities.

So, the most significant feature of the 1922 Legislative Council was that:

  • It had no legislative authority over Northern Nigeria
  • It focused on the South, especially Lagos and Calabar
  • The North remained under separate administrative control

options.text: it made laws only for the southern provinces
the colony of lagos and the protectorate of  southern nigeria were merged
laws governing land ownership in the north were extended to the south

28266.subject: Government
28266.question_text: In Nigeria, the function of Council of States is
28266.explanation:
In Nigeria, the Council of State performs an advisory function. Under the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, the Council of State advises the President on important national matters such as:

  • Appointment of key public officers (e.g., Chief Justice of Nigeria, Chairman of INEC)

  • National census

  • Award of national honours

  • Prerogative of mercy

  • Declaration of state of emergency

It does not make laws (legislative), try cases (judicial) or conduct formal investigations.
